description: CardMesh is a keyboard-first pocket client for MeshMonitor, Meshtastic, and MeshCore, built for the M5Stack CardputerZero — the first CardputerZero client targeting all three. Talks to a MeshMonitor server over REST, and drives the onboard LoRa hat directly for both Meshtastic and MeshCore protocols (one at a time -- they share the single physical radio).

store.summary: Pocket client for MeshMonitor, Meshtastic, and MeshCore mesh networks.
store.description: CardMesh is a keyboard-first pocket client for three mesh-networking protocols at once: MeshMonitor (over REST), and direct Meshtastic/MeshCore over the onboard LoRa hat (one at a time -- they share the single physical radio, switched with a tap). An icon-grid Home screen gets you into any of the three; each has its own channel picker and chat view.
